-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies OAuth credentials and connectivity.

list-files.name: list-files
list-files.description: List files and folders in Google Drive. Supports filtering by folder, file type, and search query.

params.folderId: Optional: List files within a specific folder (use folder ID)
params.query: Optional: filename match (Drive `name contains`: prefix/token, e.g. 'Hello' matches 'HelloWorld' but 'World' does not). NOT a raw Drive query — for owner/date/fullText filters use `driveQuery`.
params.pageSize: Optional: Number of results to return (default: 10, max: 100)
params.driveQuery: Optional advanced: a raw Google Drive API v3 query clause, AND-ed with the other filters. Use for filters `query` can't express, e.g. "not 'me' in owners", "modifiedTime > '2024-01-01T00:00:00'", "fullText contains 'budget'". Inside a literal, escape a single quote as \' (Drive syntax, NOT '' ) — for a plain filename match prefer the `query` param, which escapes for you.

get-file.name: get-file
get-file.description: Get detailed information about a specific file or folder.

params.fileId: The ID of the file or folder to get information about

download-file.name: download-file
download-file.description: Download a file from Google Drive.

params.fileId: The ID of the file to download
params.outputPath: Optional: Local path to save the file (default: current directory)

upload-file.name: upload-file
upload-file.description: Upload a local file to Google Drive. By default the file is stored as-is with its real type. Pass convertTo to import it as a native Google file (e.g. an HTML/Word file → editable Google Doc).

params.filePath: Local path of the file to upload
params.parentFolderId: Optional: ID of the folder to upload to (default: root)
params.fileName: Optional: Custom name for the file (default: original filename)
params.convertTo: Optional: convert the upload into a native Google file. "document" (e.g. from HTML/Word/Markdown) → editable Google Doc; "spreadsheet" (from CSV/Excel) → Google Sheet; "presentation" (from PPTX) → Google Slides. Omit to keep the original format.

create-document.name: create-document
create-document.description: Create a native, editable Google Doc from text content. Pass the body as HTML (default, best formatting), Markdown, or plain text — Drive converts it into a real Google Doc, NOT an .html file. Use this to author documents; use upload-file only for existing local files.

params.title: Title (file name) of the new Google Doc
params.content: The document body. Interpreted according to contentType.
params.contentType: How to interpret content: "html" (default, richest formatting), "markdown", or "text" (plain). Drive converts it to a native Google Doc.
params.parentFolderId: Optional: ID of the folder to create the doc in (default: root)

create-folder.name: create-folder
create-folder.description: Create a new folder in Google Drive.

params.name: Name of the folder to create
params.parentFolderId: Optional: ID of the parent folder (default: root)

delete-file.name: delete-file
delete-file.description: Delete a file or folder from Google Drive.

params.fileId: The ID of the file or folder to delete

share-file.name: share-file
share-file.description: Share a file or folder with specific permissions.

params.fileId: The ID of the file or folder to share

search-files.name: search-files
search-files.description: Search for files in Google Drive by name, content, or properties.

params.searchTerm: Filename match (Drive `name contains`: prefix/token, not substring). For advanced filters (owners, dates, fullText) use the list-files `driveQuery` parameter.

move-file.name: move-file
move-file.description: Move a file or folder to a different location in Google Drive.

params.fileId: ID of the file/folder to move

copy-file.name: copy-file
copy-file.description: Create a copy of a file in Google Drive.

params.fileId: ID of the file to copy
params.name: Optional: Name for the copy

get-file-content.name: get-file-content
get-file-content.description: Get the plain-text content of a Google Doc or text file. Does NOT extract text from binary files (PDF, Word, etc.) — for those, download the file and use the file-processor "file-to-markdown" tool.

params.fileId: ID of the file to read
params.mimeType: Optional: Export MIME type for Google Docs (e.g., 'text/plain', 'text/html')

list-comments.name: list-comments
list-comments.description: List all comments on a file.

params.pageSize: Optional: Maximum number of comments to return (default: 100)

get-comment.name: get-comment
get-comment.description: Get a specific comment by ID.

create-comment.name: create-comment
create-comment.description: Create a comment on a file.

params.fileId: ID of the file to comment on
params.content: The text content of the comment

update-comment.name: update-comment
update-comment.description: Update the content of a comment.

params.commentId: ID of the comment to update
ID of the comment to delete

create-reply.name: create-reply
create-reply.description: Create a reply to a comment. Can also be used to resolve a comment.

params.commentId: ID of the comment to reply to
params.action: Optional: Action to perform. Use 'resolve' to resolve the comment.

list-replies.name: list-replies
list-replies.description: List all replies to a comment.

params.pageSize: Optional: Maximum number of replies to return (default: 100)
